violations.why: The ISR can reset var1 to 0 between main's write and its check, so the branch sees a value main didn't write.
The ISR can write 0 after the check, and main then overwrites it with 12 based on the stale read.
The ISR can write var1 between the check and the else-branch write, so the write rests on a stale read.
The ISR can overwrite main's 12 before func_4 reads var1, so main reads 0 instead of 12.
The ISR write between main's write and its later read breaks the assumption that var1 still holds main's value.
The ISR can change var1 between the two reads, so var3 gets inconsistent copies of var1.
